note: NPS concessionaire campground on federal land within Delaware Water Gap National Recreation Area, on Route 209 at Dingmans Ferry. Book direct through the campground's own Campspot link, not Recreation.gov. Riverfront sites on the Delaware are tent-only (no vehicles); the 35 RV sites are in the forest, set back, with 20/30/50-amp electric and water (no sewer; dump stations at the two bathhouses), back-in, rigs to 50 ft; forest boondock sites also take RVs. Dry campground, no generators, no cell service. Usually open late April to early November. 2026 rates $46 boondock, $50-52 with water and electric; Senior/Access passes 50% off up to 2 nights, 10% military. --Claude
